segments.text: Once upon a time, there was a very powerful space queen named Eduhauana.
She lived in a big floating castle in the sky called the Crimson Citadel.
One day, she looked down at a pretty blue planet far below and said, "This planet is mine now."
Her smart robot helper told her about the creatures living there—big rock giants and tiny glowing bugs who helped each other.
The queen didn't care about them.
She wanted to take the planet's special energy called "vrill."
She sent golden space giants called Anunnaki down to build big factories.
The Anunnaki made two kinds of workers:
Green lizard soldiers grown in glass jars
Sad glowing people called Igigi who used to be free but are now slaves
The Igigi prisoners had babies in space cages.
One mommy named her baby Layla and whispered, "Maybe someday we'll be free."
Meanwhile, the rock giants and glow bugs down below kept playing and working, not knowing the space people were coming to take their home.
